drhp.business: The company manufactures and supplies Steel Wires, Low Relaxation Pre-stressed Concrete (LRPC) Strands, Normal Relaxation Pre-stressed Concrete Wire and Strands, plastic pipes and plastic films (including geomembrane sheet, HDPE film and pond-lining film), used in construction, bridges, flyovers, oil & gas, automobile springs, railway sleepers and highways. It also generates power through two wind farms in Gujarat under a long-term power purchase agreement with Gujarat Urja Vikas Nigam Limited.
drhp.one_liner: D P Wires Limited is a Ratlam (Madhya Pradesh)-based manufacturer of steel wires, LRPC strands and plastic films/pipes serving India's infrastructure, oil & gas, power and automobile sectors, with a manufacturing capacity of ~84,000 MT per annum.
